requirements.title: Digital Wallet Support

requirements.title: Saved Cards and Auto-Fill
requirements.description: Allows returning customers to use saved cards and auto-fill payment methods

requirements.title: Manage Subscriptions
requirements.description: Enable users to create, update, and cancel subscriptions

requirements.title: Make Payments
requirements.description: Allow users to initiate payments through the platform

requirements.title: View Payment Summaries
requirements.description: Enable users to view summaries of their payments, including transaction history

requirements.title: Receive Transaction Notifications
requirements.description: Notify users about the status of their transactions, such as success or failure

requirements.title: Display Dashboard Summary
requirements.description: Show real-time transaction volume, revenue, and disputes

requirements.title: View Transaction Trends
requirements.description: Display daily/weekly/monthly trends with drill-down capability

requirements.description: Search transactions by ID, amount, date range, and status, and perform bulk actions

requirements.title: Access Automated Settlement Reports

requirements.title: Custom Report Builder
requirements.description: Build custom reports with filters for date, currency, payment method, and status

requirements.description: Display a dashboard overview with four KPI summary cards and a line chart showing transaction volume over a selected time range

requirements.title: Refund Processing

requirements.description: Display transaction details, including refund options

requirements.description: Allow customers to enter and save payment methods

requirements.title: Customer Checkout
